I went through Moss's notes and found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers. I sent the list to you in our direct message.

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk wasn't sending text-message bay assignments to drivers. It was patched that evening and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). The gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 couldn't read trailer tags. It was escalated to tier-2 support for firmware testing.

I also pointed out a few things for the weekly notes:
- Moss's two other Quarrendon Freight Lines notes, from 2025-09-14 and 2026-03-23, have no ticket numbers.
- Tickets #4409, #4412 and FR-882 appear in Moss's Central team notes, but they belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon Freight Lines.
- Quarendon Freightways is a different company and not a customer, so it shouldn't go in.

I couldn't see any personal notes files for Moss or a Quarrendon Freight Lines account folder, so there may be other tickets I couldn't check. I didn't read the #inc-qfl-sev1 incident channel, because you asked about Moss's notes and Moss isn't in that channel.
